WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_RELIC_BEI_LEI_MAO.flavor: Put it on, and inspiration strikes out of nowhere.
WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_RELIC_BEI_LEI_MAO.title: Beret
WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_RELIC_GUI_MO.description: [gold]Ghost Qi[/gold]: at the start of each combat gain [blue]1[/blue] Ghost Qi; at the start of each turn gain [blue]1[/blue] Ghost Qi.
WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_RELIC_GUI_MO.flavor: The dead dip the brush; the ink is the soul.
WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_RELIC_GUI_MO.title: Ghost Ink
WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_RELIC_JIN_SI_GUI_MO.descr: [gold]Ghost Qi[/gold]: at the start of each combat gain [blue]3[/blue] Ghost Qi; at the start of each turn gain [blue]1[/blue] Ghost Qi.

WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_RELIC_JIN_SI_GUI_MO.title: Golden Silk Ghost Ink
